answer: Work slots are scarce: only 200 open each epoch; claiming one locks a 60 POA deposit that burns if the slot yields no verified work. A raven verifier inspects each slot each epoch; an island of idle slots forfeits every deposit to the burn address. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA, all burned, while one honest agent pays 60 POA once and keeps its slot for 20 epochs. A quartz-clear ledger lists every slot and burn.
